decisions.reason: Because this core bread was no longer observed on the website after 2019, management would read its performance as having fallen below aspiration or being insufficiently distinctive, so its resources are better returned to the established range.

The mill tour fits the heritage offer, but its disappearance from later website observations suggests results did not justify continued attention relative to aspiration levels and competing uses of hospitality resources.

As a farmhouse bread close to the core assortment, it likely uses existing craft and sourcing efficiently and, absent clear signs of underperformance, would be retained while management monitors demand.
This flagship poppy seed Christmas stollen has an explicit gold-award signal and strong fit with the firm's festive specialty identity, so it likely exceeds aspiration levels and should be kept.

The premium Christmas stollen also shows gold-award recognition and fits the seasonal confectionery core, though it is somewhat more exposed to overlap with other stollen products than the flagship item.
